title: Count the Islands
statement: A satellite map is a grid of land (#) and water (.) cells. Land cells that touch up, down, left or right belong to the same island. Count the islands.
input_format: The first line contains r and c. Each of the next r lines has c characters, each # or a dot.

examples.explanation: There are two separate groups of land cells, so the answer is 2.

hints: Each time you find unvisited land, you have found a new island.
From that cell, visit every land cell connected to it and mark them as seen.
Use an explicit queue or stack: a recursive search can overflow on a 1000 by 1000 grid.
